# Sample reports (item 3)

**Sample data, not a real farm.** Every file here is generated by
`backend/AgroFlow.Domain.Tests/SampleReportsTests.cs` from in-memory engine
runs ("Green Farm", tomato in tubs, Feb 2026). Regenerate with:

```
AGROFLOW_WRITE_SAMPLES=1 dotnet test --filter SampleReports
```

| Setup | What the zones have |
|---|---|
| `full` | crop, planting date, soil, size, flow rate, wet/dry setup, a fresh reading, tub weather |
| `partial` | crop, soil and flow rate only - no planting date, size or wet/dry setup |
| `no-kit` | crop only - no sensor readings, no tub weather, no flow rate |

For each setup: the three report types (`waterusage`, `moisture`,
`schedule`) for one zone and for all zones (three zones), a 30-day
water-usage PDF (weekly charts), and the two workbooks.

What to look for: page 1 opens with "This week, do this"; the period is
described by its real length ("this week", "in the last 30 days"); weekly
bars past 14 days; no soil chart without the wet/dry setup; the weather
comparison only on days the tub sensor reported; one "Improve your advice"
line per step, naming every zone it applies to; all FAO-56 symbols and page
numbers only in the technical appendix.

## Enquiries & sales follow-up (item 6c)

`enquiries-follow-up.pdf` and `.xlsx`, from `EnquiryReportTests`' fixed set of
seven made-up enquiries (one outside the period), written by
`AGROFLOW_WRITE_SAMPLES=1 dotnet test --filter EnquiryReport`. No real
person's details: the report never reads names, phone numbers or emails.

What to look for: "Do this next" first (call-backs due today, enquiries past
the promised 2 working days, three unanswered calls, the top reason for
"no"); then the five figures, and one chart per question, each heading kept
on the page with its chart.
